title: Third GTA6 Video Leaks As Rockstar Scrambles To Remove Footage
description: Another video of what appears to be legitimate GTA 6 gameplay has leaked online with the CyberLeek watermark, as Rockstar scrambles to remove it.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Third Seemingly Real GTA 6 Video Leaks Online

According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, another video of what appears to be legitimate Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay has leaked online. Once again, the circulating footage bears the watermark of the group allegedly connected with earlier leaks, CyberLeek.

### Rockstar Scrambles to Remove Footage

As the leaked material continues to circulate across various online platforms, the gaming community has quickly reacted to the new footage. Given the massive anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming title, any potential look at the game generates intense discussion worldwide.

In response to the unauthorized distribution, Rockstar Games is reportedly scrambling to remove the footage from the internet as quickly as possible. Major game developers typically act swiftly to issue copyright takedowns and protect their unreleased intellectual property from premature exposure.

### Editor's Take

While the video bears the CyberLeek watermark and resembles actual gameplay, the authenticity of this footage remains unconfirmed by official sources. Players and fans should approach these leaks with caution and wait for official announcements from Rockstar Games.
